description: We created Canary, a platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to monitor astronauts’ physical and mental health during space missions. It tracks vital signs, sleep, stress, mood, and cognitive performance, comparing each astronaut’s data with their personal baseline to detect potential health risks. The system also provides personalized recommendations, emergency guidance, and a 3D human body visualization, supporting crew safety and well-being during long-duration missions.
